rules.rule:
MediaVore project rules (Flutter/Dart, see CLAUDE.md). In addition to the generic checklist, check:

## Async and state
- A future started without `await` (`unawaited(...)`, `.then`, a fire-and-forget closure) whose side effects are read right after by the caller (e.g. a provider reloading notifications or quick-add items from the DB) is a stale-state bug. Flag it and name the reader.
- Optimistic UI updates must roll back only their own change; restoring a snapshot taken before the await erases concurrent changes. Flag buttons that stay enabled while their async action runs if a double tap can race.
- After an `await` in a widget or State, `context` and `setState` require a `mounted` / `context.mounted` check.
- Memoisation of network results should also memoise failures when the loop would otherwise retry the same failing call per item (offline case).

## Architecture
- `lib/features/<feature>/domain` imports neither `data` nor `presentation`; `data` does not import `presentation`.
- No `dynamic` duck typing between providers: use a typed interface.
- Decoded JSON is read through explicit casts or the project's typed JSON helpers, never through calls on `dynamic`.

## Conventions
- `debugPrint`, never `print`.
- User-facing text comes from `context.l10n.<key>` (ARB files), never a hardcoded string.
- Persistence uses `isar_community` (`package:isar_community/isar.dart`), never the upstream `isar` package.
- Generated files (`*.g.dart`, `*.config.dart`, `lib/l10n/generated/`) are never hand-edited.
- Zero duplication: flag copy-pasted logic that an existing helper already covers.

MediaVore test rules (see CLAUDE.md, Tests):
- Test files mirror the source path and end in `_test.dart`; `group(...)` + `test('should ...')`.
- Mocks use `mocktail`; shared mocks live in `test/helpers/mocks.dart`.
- When the code under test fires work without awaiting it, a test must check the observable order (what the caller reads afterwards), not only that the call happened.
- Flag tests that only assert a mock was called while the behaviour under review is the resulting state.

Localization files. `app_en.arb` is the template; every key added, renamed or removed there must change identically in `app_fr.arb`. Placeholders (names and types in `@key`) must match between languages and with their use in Dart. A key that no Dart code reads any more must be removed. French strings follow the existing style: « » quotes and a space before : ; ! ?.

GitHub Actions workflows: pin third-party actions to a major version or SHA, keep `permissions` minimal (read-only unless a job writes), never print secrets, keep the Flutter version in a single `FLUTTER_VERSION` env. Checks that gate merges must not use `continue-on-error`.
